address: 46 Golborne Road, Notting Hill, London, W10 5PR, United Kingdom
bio: ‘Fire, wine, vinyl’ it says outside this cool Notting Hill spot – and that pretty much sums it up. The sharing plates benefit from the kitchen’s skill at cooking over an open fire – don’t miss the black carrot with sea urchin sauce; wines are varied and well chosen; and downstairs a DJ delves deep into a diverse album collection. Come with friends for a fun night out....
